exposure: maternal infection in pregnancy (first, second or third trimester)
COVID-19 disease severity (NIH categories asymptomatic, mild/moderate or severe/critical)
cohort: The study included infants born to mothers with COVID-19 during pregnancy (cases) and prepandemic neurotypical unexposed control infants matched by gestational age, gender, and post-term age.
finding: Infants exposed to antenatal COVID-19 more frequently exhibited suboptimal neuromotor development and developmental delays compared with prepandemic controls, with maternal fever during pregnancy specifically associated with developmental delay.
